card.fact_statement: Cambodia's Ministry of Culture and Fine Arts condemned Thai military attacks on Prasat Ta Khwai.
card.source_span: Cambodia's Ministry of Culture and Fine Arts condemned Thai military attacks on Prasat Ta Khwai, describing them as "profoundly immoral" and a violation of cultural heritage.
